description: Exports a report as PDF or PowerPoint and answers a download link valid for 15 minutes. At most 10 exports a minute per user.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

format.description: The kind of file to create. `pdf` is a PDF of the report's visible slides; hidden slides are left out. `pptx` is a PowerPoint file in which hidden slides are included but stay hidden, speaker notes are kept, and charts are images rather than editable charts.

slideIds.description: The slides to export, from `getReportContent` or a reply's `changedSlideIds`. The file keeps the report's slide order whatever order you list them in. Ids that are not slides of the report are ignored, and so are hidden slides in a PDF. If omitted, the whole report is exported.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: exportReport
title: Export report
